name: Wahoo
verdict: Wahoo is a private connected-fitness company from Atlanta: after a 2021 majority sale to Rhône Group, it was recapitalised in 2023 under founder Chip Hawkins with 'equal' new and existing investors. Nothing found.
note: Connected-fitness hardware (trainers, GPS computers, sensors). Official partner of Fenix-Premier Tech; on the bib shorts of the 2026 kit.
